decisive_spans.text: Patient admitted to self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm present

response.rationale: The presence of foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with foamy cytoplasm, along with the patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections, strongly supports a foreign body granuloma. While D4 is also supported by the injection history, D2 directly addresses the histological findings.
